allow_large: Owner-approved 2026-09-29 for legacy clean-ups: removes field-specific rejections for job fields that no longer exist; those fields now get the generic unknown-field rejection; no new API surface
done_when: The jobs API, IPC task parsing and scheduler MCP tools no longer mention groupScope, group_scope, requiredTools, required_tools or GANTRY_GROUP_FOLDER; the tool schema no longer advertises required_tools; tests updated

findings.body: The HTTP test sends `unexpectedField`, which already received this generic response before the fix; restoring every deleted field-specific error would leave it passing. The new IPC test likewise exercises an unrelated field and calls the parser directly. The scheduler tests capture schemas/handlers instead of exercising MCP, and no remaining test verifies that discovery omits `required_tools` or that startup succeeds with `GANTRY_GROUP_FOLDER` present. Thus the explicit end-to-end regression-test requirement remains unmet. Add suite-wired tests through the running API/IPC and MCP entry points that exercise the removed names, assert generic responses, verify the advertised schemas, and cover startup with the obsolete environment variable. These tests must fail when the corresponding removed behavior returns.
findings.title: Not done: End-to-end regression tests for removed job and scheduler fields

why: Specific 'no longer accepted' errors for removed job and scheduler fields keep old field names alive, and required_tools is still shown to the model as a deprecated tool parameter
